BUILDING CONSTRUCTION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. International Cricket Team

2. When learning Computer Aided Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Aided Drawing.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Aided Drawing.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Computer Aided Drawing.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Aided Drawing.

3. When learning Foundations, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Foundations.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Foundations.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Foundations.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Foundations.

4. When learning Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.1 Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Dr, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.1 Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Dr.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.1 Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Dr.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.1 Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Dr.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.1 Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Dr.

5. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Speaker
   C. Keyboard
   D. Monitor

6. When learning Concreting 3.2 Foundations 3.3 Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floor, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Concreting 3.2 Foundations 3.3 Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floor.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Concreting 3.2 Foundations 3.3 Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floor.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Concreting 3.2 Foundations 3.3 Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floor.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Concreting 3.2 Foundations 3.3 Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floor.

7. When learning Site Preparation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Site Preparation.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Site Preparation.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Site Preparation.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Site Preparation.

8. When learning Introduction to Building Construction, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Building Construction.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Building Construction.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Building Construction.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Building Construction.

9. When learning Isometric Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Isometric Drawing.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Isometric Drawing.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Isometric Drawing.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Isometric Drawing.

10. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

11. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Work alone with eyes closed

12. When learning Timbering, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Timbering.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Timbering.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Timbering.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Timbering.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Plumbing Materials and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Pipework and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Building Construction 1.2 Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Building Construction and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. C — Information and Communication Technology

2. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Aided Drawing.

3. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Foundations.

4. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.1 Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Dr.

5. A — CPU

6. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Concreting 3.2 Foundations 3.3 Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floor.

7. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Site Preparation.

8. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Building Construction.

9. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Isometric Drawing.

10. D — Never touch live wires with wet hands

11. B — Wear safety gear and follow instructions

12. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Timbering.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Plumbing Materials; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Pipework; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Introduction to Building Construction 1.2 Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Introduction to Building Construction; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
